what_this_is: The Workshop row for the tool in tools/reply-templates: what it does, what it takes and gives back, and how it runs.

payload.label: Expand a canned reply template
payload.job: Fill a canned reply template with the details of a request, such as a name or a button label, and give back the finished reply
payload.description: Give a template (any JSON in which a value to fill is written as {"$kind":"binding","select":{"from":"dataSource","key":"caller_request","path":"label"},"default":...}) and the details to fill it from: caller_request, provider_record and data (each top-level entry of data can also be named as a key). If you give no template, the provider_record's template is used. Returns the template with every binding replaced; everything else is kept as it was, whatever its shape. A binding that finds nothing gives its default, else null (select.required changes nothing). An object key named itemTemplate is kept as written. A template that is present and null gives null. A binding that reads from another source or has a transform is refused by name. It sends nothing and keeps nothing; the caller delivers the reply.

template.description: The template to fill; wins over the provider record's

provider_record.description: Whoever offers the reply; its template field is used when template is not given

caller_request.description: The details of what is being replied to

data.description: More details; each top-level entry is also a key a binding can name

reply.description: The template with every binding filled
